title: Hands-on exam
description: The optional lab_exam block of an exam file (exams/<group>/<exam>.yaml): the exam offers a hands-on exam, a timed set of labs drawn by domain weight and run on `clusters.count` kind clusters built from one profile. The content sync checks that enough eligible labs exist and sends the block to astrona-svc-labs as a hands-on exam definition.

tasks.description: How many labs an attempt draws: a number from min to max.

break_minutes.description: The longest one break may last.

pass_score.description: Defaults to the exam's own pass_score.

max_breaks.description: Defaults to the exam's own max_breaks.

count.description: How many clusters the student's machine builds before the clock starts.

kind.description: The profile every cluster is built from, in a lab config's runtime.kind shape. A lab is eligible only if its own kind config fits: same node counts and CNI, addons a subset of these.
